SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as blogerName, v.title as content, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0
AND v.title like '%${paramMap.search}%'
AND v.vloger_id != #{paramMap.myId}
ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as blogerName, v.title as content, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{paramMap.vlogId}

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, v.title as content, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM my_liked_vlog liked JOIN vlog v ON v.id = liked.vlog_id WHERE liked.user_id = #{paramMap.userId} AND v.is_private = 0 ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as blogerName, v.title as content, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM fans f JOIN vlog v ON v.vloger_id = f.vloger_id JOIN users u ON f.vloger_id = u.id WHERE f.fan_id = #{paramMap.myUserId} AND v.is_private = 0
AND f.is_fan_friend_of_mine = 1
ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, v.title as content, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v JOIN comment c ON v.id = c.vlog_id WHERE c.id = #{paramMap.commentId} AND v.is_private = 0
